final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT s.arcref AS arcref, p.fundflux AS fundflux, AVG(1.0 * s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scans AS s JOIN projects AS p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM step1) SELECT step1.arcref, step1.fundflux, step1.avg_ratio, step1.avg_ratio - step2.overall_avg AS difference FROM step1 CROSS JOIN step2 WHERE step1.avg_ratio > step2.overall_avg ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
